headline: French Unions Call New Strike Action After Rejecting 0.6% Minimum Wage Offer
summary: Trade unions including the CGT have called for nationwide strike action across France after rejecting the government's proposed 0.6% minimum wage increase, protesting persistent inflation and purchasing power erosion.
why: France is the second-largest economy in the Eurozone, where widespread industrial action can interrupt transit networks and economic productivity.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: National strikes interrupt transport logistics and weigh on broad business activity.
